name: Dive Bomber Push-Up
instructions: Start in a downward dog position: hands and feet on the floor a bit wider than shoulder width, hips high, arms and legs straight.
Bend your elbows and lower your head and chest toward the floor between your hands.
Keep your chest close to the floor and swoop forward until your hips are low and your arms push you up into an upward dog position.
Look forward and open your chest at the top.
Bend your elbows again and sweep your chest back along the same low path, close to the floor, then straighten your arms and push your hips up into downward dog. Repeat.
